# pai obsidian

Mirror project notes into an Obsidian vault

```
pai obsidian <command>
```

Keeps an Obsidian vault in step with your project notes so you can browse them there. Sync, check health, or open the vault.

```sh
pai obsidian sync
pai obsidian status
pai obsidian open
```

See also: `pai zettel`, `pai memory search`

### pai obsidian sync

Copy project notes into the vault and rebuild its index pages

```
pai obsidian sync [options]
```

Links each project's Notes folder into the vault and regenerates the index and topic pages.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--vault PATH` | string | — | Use this vault folder instead of the configured one |
| `--quiet` | flag | — | Minimal output, for scheduled runs |

```sh
pai obsidian sync
pai obsidian sync --quiet
```

See also: `pai obsidian status`

### pai obsidian status

Check the vault: healthy, broken, orphaned and missing links

```
pai obsidian status [options]
```

Counts the vault's links by state so you can see whether a sync is needed.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--vault PATH` | string | — | Check this vault folder instead of the configured one |

```sh
pai obsidian status
pai obsidian status --vault ./vault
```

See also: `pai obsidian sync`

### pai obsidian open

Open the vault in Obsidian (macOS)

```
pai obsidian open [options]
```

Launches Obsidian on the vault folder.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--vault PATH` | string | — | Open this vault folder instead of the configured one |

```sh
pai obsidian open
pai obsidian open --vault ./vault
```

See also: `pai obsidian sync`
